headline: RBA Deputy Governor Concedes Public Trust in Central Bank Is Under Strain
summary: Reserve Bank of Australia Deputy Governor acknowledged that trust in the institution is facing strain during a crucial period for monetary policy execution.
why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets official interest rates, directly driving national mortgage rates, banking liquidity, and inflation targets.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Public and market trust in RBA policy execution affects monetary policy transmission and inflation expectations.
